title: Governance and Investment Readiness | GOP
description: GOP prepares promoter-led businesses for investment: MIS, governance, delegation, management depth and diligence readiness, before an investor asks.

nodes.name: Governance and Investment Readiness
nodes.description: Investors fund institutions, not individuals. GOP helps promoter-led businesses build what an outsider needs to trust: reporting that reconciles, true margin by product and customer, governance and delegation that do not depend on one person, management depth, and a growth plan that shows how capital turns into earnings.

audience.audienceType: Promoter-led businesses, primarily INR 150-500 crore revenue, and their investors
